surprise_only_baseline.description: Post-release analogs matched by indicator and surprise direction/semantic effect only.

hierarchical_regime.description: Adds point-in-time headline inflation regime similarity with hierarchical fallback.
hierarchical_regime.interpretation: negative Brier difference is better than default

surprise_magnitude.description: Adds point-in-time surprise magnitude bucket similarity with fallback to the default surprise-only analog set.
surprise_magnitude.interpretation: negative Brier difference is better than default

promotion_policy: Do not promote a challenger using the same historical sample used to design it. Keep challengers research-only until an independently locked out-of-sample evaluation is available.
live_use_note: This registry controls research model status only. It does not constitute a trading recommendation.
